about: On the client's character creation definition entity (the one with eoc::character_creation::CharacterDefinitionComponent): what the shown dummy is built from (Race, Subrace, BodyType, BodyShape, RootTemplate, Origin, Classes, Visual) and Dummy, the client-only entity drawn on the creation screen (it carries ecl::character_creation::DummyComponent, Visual, AnimationBlueprint, Transform).

evidence.says: the component ClientCCDummyDefinition, engine name from Ext.Debug.GetComponentTypes

in SYS_CC_I two entities carry it (the character and the companion definition); the character's Dummy stands at 9.99 0.89 111.14 before the creation camera, while the server's player characters stand elsewhere and are not in the view

questions.ask: which function rebuilds the dummy when the server's CharacterDefinition changes, to learn whether a saved appearance written into the definition is drawn
